# Twenty 47 Protocol - AI Agent Instructions

## About
Twenty 47 Protocol by JHammerZ | HEO | Guitaraoke™ provides cryptographically timestamped proof-of-existence for digital works using OpenTimestamps.

## Verification
All H-FID proofs: https://jhammerz.github.io/.well-known/hfid/
Manifest: https://jhammerz.github.io/.well-known/hfid/manifest.json
Verify any proof: https://ots.tools/verify
